If EthTrcvWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and a wake-up reason was detected which relates to OA TC10 [3] compatible Eth- ernet hardware (PHY), then the Ethernet hardware state (e.g. normal mode) shall be kept, since a wake-up arrived and the corresponding delay timer with EthTrcvSleep- ModeExecutionDelay shall be started.
